purpose_zh: 将正文中的关键事实指向原始来源ID、用途边界和待补证条件；本索引不新增事实权威性。
purpose_en: Maps key narrative facts to source IDs, permitted-use boundaries, and evidence gaps. This index adds no authority beyond the underlying sources.

facts.statement_zh: 征集公告提供三层约规模、文字范围和三处重点区域任务，但未随包提供正式矢量边界。
facts.statement_en: The Open Call provides approximate scales, written scopes, and three key-area tasks, but no official vector boundary is supplied with the package.

facts.statement_zh: 众智园和大钟寺历史更新公示链接截至2026-08-12已撤稿或删除。
facts.statement_en: The historical Zhongzhiyuan and Dazhongsi renewal-notice links were withdrawn or deleted as of 2026-08-12.

facts.statement_zh: 蓝景丽家约5.03公顷、约9.65万平方米及交通预测仅适用于对应实施单元。
facts.statement_en: The approximately 5.03 ha area, 96,500 m² floor area, and traffic forecast for Lanjing Lijia apply only to the corresponding implementation unit.

facts.statement_zh: 一期实施和二期配套工程完成不等同于约9公里全线连续开放或无障碍。
facts.statement_en: Phase I implementation and completion of Phase II supporting works do not establish continuous or accessible public use along the full approximately 9 km corridor.

facts.statement_zh: AI原点约3平方公里分布式载体网络及人才服务可支撑机制研究，不构成具体空间授权。
facts.statement_en: AI Origin's approximately 3 km² distributed network and talent services support mechanism research but do not authorize a specific site.

facts.statement_zh: 中关村东路8号原点大厦（原东升大厦）裙房一层AI原点社区展厅的既有装修工程规模为1650平方米，施工许可证号为110108202606050403，并于2026年7月20日取得京竣联验（海）字〔2026〕1380号联合验收通知书。
facts.statement_en: The existing fit-out project for the AI Origin Community exhibition hall on the first floor of the podium at Origin Building (formerly Dongsheng Building), 8 Zhongguancun East Road, has a permitted project scale of 1,650 m², construction permit number 110108202606050403, and joint-acceptance notice Jing Jun Lian Yan (Hai) No. 1380 dated 20 July 2026.

facts.statement_zh: 公开报道记录2026年7月29日一次有组织参观：参观者在讲解员引导下参观AI原点社区展厅各展区，随后由原点大厦北门步出并沿AI原点社区大街步行；既有装修工程招标人为北京市东升农工商总公司，招标范围列明互动查询、会议预约、政务网络、显示、门禁、消防和机电系统。
facts.statement_en: Public reporting records one organised visit on 29 July 2026: participants toured the AI Origin Community exhibition hall's display areas under a guide, then exited through Origin Building's north gate and walked along AI Origin Community Street. The existing fit-out tender names Beijing Dongsheng Agricultural and Industrial Corporation (北京市东升农工商总公司) as the procuring entity and lists interactive enquiry, meeting booking, government network, display, access control, fire-safety, and MEP systems.

facts.statement_zh: AI原点社区周边约1.7万平方米整治的官方完工报道列明871米新建或修复人行步道、16处1080个非机动车位、270米拆围和约4700平方米释放空间。
facts.statement_en: Official completion reporting for approximately 17,000 m² of public-realm works around AI Origin lists 871 m of new or repaired footway, 16 locations with 1,080 bicycle spaces, 270 m of removed fencing, and about 4,700 m² of released space.

facts.statement_zh: 同一既有装修工程三名中标候选人的公开投标报价为1995.101931万元、2038.708979万元和2040.3万元，该工程规模为1650平方米；采购公告核实融HUB位于原点大厦原餐厅空间及其采购范围，成交公告核实金额为110.102263万元。
facts.statement_en: The three published candidate bids for the same existing fit-out project were CNY 19,951,019.31, 20,387,089.79, and 20,403,000; that project's scale is 1,650 m². The procurement notice verifies that RongHUB is located in the former restaurant space in Origin Building and states its scope; the award notice verifies the amount of CNY 1,101,022.63.

facts.statement_zh: 中关村东路8号是既有装修工程规模1650平方米的一层展厅项目建设地址；成府路45号是另一条招标人联系地址和AI原点社区A座B1层活动地址记录。两条记录分别登记，宗地、楼座和资产关系待核，不互换建筑、房号或步行距离。
facts.statement_en: 8 Zhongguancun East Road is the construction address of the ground-floor exhibition-hall project whose existing fit-out project scale is 1,650 m². 45 Chengfu Road appears in a separate tenderer-contact and AI Origin Community Building A, B1 event record. The records remain separate; their parcel, building-block, and asset relationship is pending verification, and building, room, or walking-distance claims are not transferred between them.

facts.statement_zh: OSM道路、步骑、轨道、站点和水系日期为2026-08-11，建筑为2026-07-08，POI为2026-05-06，仅作L4工作底图。
facts.statement_en: OSM roads, walking and cycling, rail, stations, and water are dated 2026-08-11; buildings 2026-07-08; POIs 2026-05-06; all are L4 working-basemap material only.

facts.statement_zh: L5临时范围SITE-001与L4具名京张铁路遗址公园多边形不重叠，EPSG:4547平面最短边界距离为412.6839494317米，正文显示为约413米。
facts.statement_en: The L5 provisional SITE-001 extent and L4 named Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park polygons do not overlap; planar minimum boundary distance in EPSG:4547 is 412.6839494317 m, displayed as approximately 413 m.
